description: Source code for AHardwareBuffer management in Android, including allocation, description, locking, unlocking, and handle transfer functions.

classes.name: AHardwareBuffer
classes.description: Functions for managing hardware buffers in Android, including creation, description, locking, unlocking, and handle transfer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_allocate
methods.description: Allocates a new hardware buffer based on the provided description.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_acquire
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the hardware buffer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of the hardware buffer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_describe
methods.description: Fills out a description struct with details of the hardware buffer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_lockAndGetInfo
methods.description: Locks the buffer and retrieves information such as virtual address, bytes per pixel, and stride.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_lockPlanes
methods.description: Locks the buffer and retrieves plane information, supporting YUV formats.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_sendHandleToUnixSocket
methods.description: Sends the buffer handle over a Unix socket.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_recvHandleFromUnixSocket
methods.description: Receives a buffer handle from a Unix socket.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a buffer description is supported.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of the buffer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_readFromParcel
methods.description: Reads a buffer from a parcel.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a parcel.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_getNativeHandle
methods.description: Returns the native handle associated with the buffer.

methods.name: AHardwareBuffer_createFromHandle
methods.description: Creates a buffer from an existing native handle.
